  Reconcile this repo's fathom wiring in place — hooks vs the current
  template, stale binary paths repointed to the PATH shim, stanza
  regenerated, index refreshed with a canonical root, then proven by
  demonstration. Use when doctor or the session line reports wiring
  drift, after a fathom upgrade, when hooks feel silent, or whenever a
  repo was wired by hand at an unknown vintage. Knows doctor's known
  false signals so you don't chase wrong-repo readings.

<!-- fathom:owned — generated by `fathom init --skills`; safe to delete this line to adopt the file as your own -->

The one-command form (preferred when available):

```sh
fathom fleet reconcile --repo . && fathom fleet reconcile --repo . --apply
```

Dry-run first, read the diff, then apply — reconcile repoints stale
absolute binary paths to the shim-stable `fathom` and merges missing
template entries at exactly one scope (project, deferring to user scope).
Structural changes (scope moves, removals) are yours, not the verb's.

## The manual pass (when reconcile is unavailable or you need the audit)

1. `fathom doctor` — but do NOT chase these known false signals:
   `binary_fresh` compares against THIS repo's HEAD in non-fathom repos
   (skip-noted on current binaries); `hooks_installed` may cite beat-log
   evidence from OTHER repos (the log is user-global; rows without a
   `project_dir` predate the stamp); a `binding_file` FAIL on
   `bindings: []` means a stale binary — explicit-empty is valid.
2. Read `.claude/settings.json` at project AND user scope. The current
   template: SessionStart(startup|resume|clear|compact)→`fathom
   session-hook` t10; PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit)→`fathom
   edit-hook` t5; PreToolUse ×3 t5 — (Edit|Write|MultiEdit), (Bash),
   (Grep|Glob|Read) — all →`fathom edit-hook --pre`; Stop→`fathom
   stop-hook` t10. Reconcile in place at whichever ONE scope already has
   fathom hooks; rewrite absolute `/…/fathom` commands to plain `fathom`.
3. `.fathomignore` covers secrets/data/vendored/build — BEFORE any first
   ingest.
4. `fathom gen-claude-md` and merge — the stanza must say fathom (never a
   pre-rename name) and spell commands via plain `fathom`.
5. Ingest with BOTH fields — `{"service":"<plain-name>","path":"<canonical
   absolute root>"}`. The daemon now refuses path-like ids, duplicate
   roots (naming the claimant), and nested roots; `rename_service` /
   `remove_service` fix historical registrations.
6. Prove by demonstration: `list_services` shows this repo at its
   canonical path; make a trivial edit and confirm a beat lands
   (`tail -5 ~/.fathom/hooks.jsonl`).
7. `fathom observe` anything that deviated; report a before/after table.
